subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. 

QUICKER : TGMEKWS:: REPORTS:?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48003724b8dc424c58c45f2d138ed98998a90c88e3918b7aff60b440b4ab1b52.png] 

**Logic: Next alternate or (+2) of each letter is written and then reversed.**

So, 

 
• QUICKER: TGMEKWS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aab43bfca31480cbd798b7b2bdf891de83174f707710c3485da090616bfba41.png] 

⇒ Therefore, 'REPORTS' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76477415f6a6092dd99bf441b58d7bdbc6722101f36cc139692609f8d20ab447.png] ​

Hence, **"****UVTQRGT"** is the correct answer.

74:T
